summary.fallback_scope: same 3x3 owner stencil, Coverage required, owner=0 excluded, no search expansion

decision: no production owner fallback or threshold change; all scale points had uniform 3x3 owner, and the owner coverage point had no covered neighbor; a future candidate needs source resampling plus full QG evidence.
limitations: The run exports diagnostics through a new test-only stack-lab flag; it does not enable framed-artwork mode.
The diagnostic run and baseline have identical preview/crop digests and QG fields, but TIFF byte equality is not claimed because the raster export differs at low-level bytes between independent runs.
scale=0.25 remains D1 diagnostic evidence and cannot be promoted to native D2/D3/D4/D5.
